framework: Portfolio Manager — 페르소나 컨센서스 + Risk Manager + thesis alignment 통합 의사결정
decision_methodology: signal_score = (bullish_pct - bearish_pct) × avg_confidence × thesis_alignment_factor / risk_score_multiplier. 의교창 멀티플 framework 적합도가 thesis_alignment_factor에 반영됨.
